verses.en: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.pt: Naquele dia, Jesus saiu de casa e se sentou junto ao mar.
verses.en_web: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.
verses.en_bbe: On that day Jesus went out of the house and was seated by the seaside.

verses.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.pt: E ajuntaram-se perto dele tantas multidões, de maneira que ele entrou num barco e se sentou; e toda a multidão ficou na praia,
verses.en_web: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
verses.en_bbe: And great numbers of people came together to him, so that he got into a boat; and the people took up their position by the sea.

verses.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.pt: E ele lhes falou muitas coisas por parábolas. Ele disse: Eis que o semeador saiu a semear.
verses.en_web: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, A man went out to put seed in the earth;

verses.en: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.pt: E enquanto semeava, caiu parte das sementes junto ao caminho, e vieram as aves e a comeram.
verses.en_web: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.en_bbe: And while he did so, some seeds were dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took them for food:

verses.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.pt: E outra parte caiu entre pedras, onde não havia muita terra, e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra funda.
verses.en_web: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
verses.en_bbe: And some of the seed went among the stones, where it had not much earth, and straight away it came up because the earth was not deep:

verses.en: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.pt: Mas quando o sol surgiu, queimou-se; e por não ter raiz, secou-se.
verses.en_web: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.en_bbe: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root it became dry and dead.

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.pt: E outra parte caiu entre espinhos, e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram.
verses.en_web: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
verses.en_bbe: And some seeds went among thorns, and the thorns came up and they had no room for growth:

verses.en: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.pt: E outra parte caiu em boa terra, e rendeu fruto: um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.
verses.en_web: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
verses.en_bbe: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

verses.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.pt: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.en_web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.en_bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear.

verses.en: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.pt: Então os discípulos se aproximaram, e lhe perguntaram: Por que falas a eles por parábolas?
verses.en_web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples came and said to him, Why do you say things to them in the form of stories?

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.pt: E ele lhes respondeu: Porque a vós é dado saber os mistérios do Reino dos céus, mas a eles não é dado.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them in answer, To you is given the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

verses.en: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.pt: Pois a quem tem, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; mas a quem não tem, até aquilo que tem lhe será tirado.
verses.en_web: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
verses.en_bbe: Because whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have more; but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

verses.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.pt: Por isso falo a eles por parábolas; porque vendo, não veem; e ouvindo, não ouvem, nem entendem.
verses.en_web: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason I put things into the form of stories; because they see without seeing, and give ear without hearing, and the sense is not clear to them.

verses.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.pt: Assim neles se cumpre a profecia de Isaías, que diz: De fato ouvireis, mas não entendereis; De fato vereis, mas não percebereis.
verses.en_web: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:
verses.en_bbe: And for them the words of Isaiah have come true, Though you give ear, you will not get knowledge; and seeing, you will see, but the sense will not be clear to you:

verses.en: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.pt: Porque o coração deste povo está insensível; Com seus ouvidos dificilmente ouvem, e seus olhos fecharam; A fim de não haver que seus olhos vejam, seus ouvidos ouçam, Seus corações entendam, e se arrependam, E eu os cure. Isaías 6:9-10
verses.en_web: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again; and I would heal them.’
verses.en_bbe: For the heart of this people has become fat and their ears are slow in hearing and their eyes are shut; for fear that they might see with their eyes and give hearing with their ears and become wise in their hearts and be turned again to me, so that I might make them well.

verses.en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.pt: Mas benditos são os vossos olhos, porque veem; e os vossos ouvidos, porque ouvem.
verses.en_web: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
verses.en_bbe: But a blessing be on your eyes, because they see; and on your ears, because they are open.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.pt: Pois em verdade vos digo que muitos profetas e justos desejaram ver o que vós vedes, mas não viram; e desejaram ouvir o que vós ouvis, mas não ouviram.
verses.en_web: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
verses.en_bbe: For truly, I say to you that prophets and upright men had a desire to see the things which you see, and saw them not; and to have knowledge of the words which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.pt: Portanto, ouvi vós a parábola do semeador:
verses.en_web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, then, to the story of the man who put the seed in the earth.

verses.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.pt: Quando alguém ouve a palavra do Reino e não a entende, o maligno vem e arranca o que foi semeado em seu coração; este é o que foi semeado junto ao caminho.
verses.en_web: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
verses.en_bbe: When the word of the kingdom comes to anyone, and the sense of it is not clear to him, then the Evil One comes, and quickly takes away that which was put in his heart. He is the seed dropped by the wayside.

verses.en: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.pt: E o que foi semeado entre as pedras é o que ouve a palavra, e logo a recebe com alegria,
verses.en_web: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
verses.en_bbe: And that which went on the stones, this is he who, hearing the word, straight away takes it with joy;

verses.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.pt: mas não tem raiz em si mesmo. Em vez disso, dura um pouco, mas quando vem a aflição ou a perseguição pela palavra, logo tropeça na fé.
verses.en_web: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
verses.en_bbe: But having no root in himself, he goes on for a time; and when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, he quickly becomes full of doubts.

verses.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.pt: E o que foi semeado entre os espinhos é o que ouve a palavra, mas a ansiedade com o tempo presente e a sedução das riquezas sufocam a palavra, e fica sem dar fruto.
verses.en_web: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.en_bbe: And that which was dropped among the thorns, this is he who has the word; and the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, put a stop to the growth of the word and it gives no fruit.

verses.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.pt: Mas o que foi semeado em boa terra, este é o que ouve e entende a palavra, e o que dá e produz fruto, um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.
verses.en_web: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
verses.en_bbe: And the seed which was put in good earth, this is he who gives ear to the word, and gets the sense of it; who gives fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.pt: E ele lhes declarou outra parábola, dizendo: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem que semeia boa semente em seu campo,
verses.en_web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave them another story, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a man who put good seed in his field:

verses.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.pt: Mas, enquanto as pessoas dormiam, o inimigo dele veio, semeou joio entre o trigo, e foi embora.
verses.en_web: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
verses.en_bbe: But while men were sleeping, one who had hate for him came and put evil seeds among the grain, and went away.

verses.en: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.pt: E, quando a erva cresceu e produziu fruto, então apareceu também o joio.
verses.en_web: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
verses.en_bbe: But when the green stem came up and gave fruit, the evil plants were seen at the same time.

verses.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.pt: Então os servos do dono da propriedade chegaram, e lhe perguntaram: “Senhor, não semeaste boa semente no teu campo? De onde, pois, veio o joio?”
verses.en_web: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
verses.en_bbe: And the servants of the master of the house came and said to him, Sir, did you not put good seed in your field? how then has it evil plants?

verses.en: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.pt: E ele lhes respondeu: “Um inimigo fez isto”. Em seguida, os servos lhe perguntaram: “Queres, pois, que vamos e o tiremos?”
verses.en_web: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Someone has done this in hate. And the servants say to him, Is it your pleasure that we go and take them up?

verses.en: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.pt: Ele, porém, lhes respondeu: “Não, para não haver que, enquanto tirais o joio, arranqueis com ele também o trigo.
verses.en_web: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
verses.en_bbe: But he says, No, for fear that by chance while you take up the evil plants, you may be rooting up the grain with them.

verses.en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.pt: Deixai-os crescer ambos juntos até a colheita; e no tempo da colheita direi aos que colhem: ‘Recolhei primeiro o joio, e amarrai-o em molhos, para o queimarem; mas ao trigo ajuntai no meu celeiro’.”
verses.en_web: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
verses.en_bbe: Let them come up together till the getting in of the grain; and then I will say to the workers, Take up first the evil plants, and put them together for burning: but put the grain into my store-house.

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.pt: Ele lhes propôs outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um grão de mostarda que alguém tomou e semeou no seu campo.
verses.en_web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;
verses.en_bbe: He put another story before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his field:

verses.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.pt: De fato, dentre todas as sementes, esta é a menor. Mas quando cresce, é a maior das hortaliças; e se torna tamanha árvore, que as aves do céu vêm e se aninham em seus ramos.
verses.en_web: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
verses.en_bbe: Which is smaller than all seeds; but when it has come up it is greater than the plants, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and make their resting-places in its branches.

verses.en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.pt: Ele lhes disse outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante ao fermento que uma mulher tomou e misturou em três medidas de farinha, até que tudo ficasse fermentado.
verses.en_web: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
verses.en_bbe: Another story he gave to them: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and put in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.

verses.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.pt: Tudo isto Jesus falou por parábolas às multidões. Sem parábolas ele não lhes falava,
verses.en_web: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
verses.en_bbe: All these things Jesus said to the people in the form of stories; and without a story he said nothing to them:

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.pt: para que se cumprisse o que foi falado pelo profeta, que disse: Abrirei a minha boca em parábolas; Pronunciarei coisas escondidas desde a fundação do mundo. Salmos 78:2
verses.en_web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
verses.en_bbe: That it might come true which was said by the prophet, Opening my mouth, I will give out stories; I will give knowledge of things kept secret from before all time.

verses.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.pt: Então Jesus despediu as multidões, e foi para casa. Seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: Explica-nos a parábola do joio do campo.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he went away from the people, and went into the house; and his disciples came to him, saying, Make clear to us the story of the evil plants in the field.

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.pt: E ele lhes respondeu: O que semeia a boa semente é o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
verses.en_bbe: And he made answer and said, He who puts the good seed in the earth is the Son of man;

verses.en: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.pt: E o campo é o mundo; e a boa semente, estes são os filhos do Reino; e o joio são os filhos do maligno.
verses.en_web: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
verses.en_bbe: And the field is the world; and the good seed is the sons of the kingdom; and the evil seeds are the sons of the Evil One;

verses.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.pt: E o inimigo, que o semeou, é o diabo; e a colheita é o fim da era; e os que colhem são os anjos.
verses.en_web: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
verses.en_bbe: And he who put them in the earth is Satan; and the getting in of the grain is the end of the world; and those who get it in are the angels.

verses.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.pt: Portanto, como o joio é colhido e queimado no fogo, assim também será no fim desta era.
verses.en_web: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
verses.en_bbe: As then the evil plants are got together and burned with fire, so will it be in the end of the world.

verses.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.pt: O Filho do homem enviará seus anjos, e eles recolherão do seu Reino todas as causas do pecado, assim como os que praticam injustiça,
verses.en_web: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,
verses.en_bbe: The Son of man will send out his angels, and they will take out of his kingdom everything which is a cause of error, and all those who do wrong,

verses.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.pt: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.
verses.en_web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
verses.en_bbe: And will put them into the fire; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

verses.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.pt: Então os justos brilharão como o sol, no Reino de seu Pai. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.en_web: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.en_bbe: Then will the upright be shining as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him give ear.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.pt: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a um tesouro escondido num campo, que um homem, depois de achá-lo, escondeu. Então, em sua alegria, vai, vende tudo quanto tem, e compra aquele campo.
verses.en_web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
verses.en_bbe: The kingdom of heaven is like a secret store of wealth in a field, which a man came across and put back again; and in his joy he goes and gives all he has, to get that field.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.pt: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a um homem negociante, que buscava boas pérolas.
verses.en_web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
verses.en_bbe: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a trader searching for beautiful jewels.

verses.en: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.pt: Quando este achou uma pérola de grande valor, foi, vendeu tudo quanto tinha, e a comprou.
verses.en_web: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.en_bbe: And having come across one jewel of great price, he went and gave all he had in exchange for it.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.pt: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a uma rede lançada ao mar, que colhe toda espécie de peixes.
verses.en_web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,
verses.en_bbe: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, which was put into the sea and took in every sort of fish:

verses.en: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.pt: E quando está cheia, os pescadores puxam-na à praia, sentam-se, e recolhem os bons em cestos, mas os ruins lançam fora.
verses.en_web: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
verses.en_bbe: When it was full, they took it up on the sands; and seated there they put the good into vessels, but the bad they put away.

verses.en: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.pt: Assim será ao fim da era; os anjos sairão, e separarão dentre os justos os maus,
verses.en_web: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
verses.en_bbe: So will it be in the end of the world: the angels will come and take out the bad from the good,

verses.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.pt: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.
verses.en_web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
verses.en_bbe: And will put them into the fire: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhes perguntou: Entendestes todas estas coisas?Eles lhe responderam: Sim, Senhor.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.en_bbe: Are all these things now clear to you? They say to him, Yes.

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Portanto todo escriba que se tornou discípulo no Reino dos céus é semelhante a um chefe de casa, que do seu tesouro tira coisas novas e velhas.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, For this reason every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house, who gives out from his store things new and old.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou essas parábolas, retirou-se dali.
verses.en_web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus had come to the end of these stories he went away from there.

verses.en: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.pt: E vindo à sua terra, ensinava-os na sinagoga deles, de tal maneira que ficavam admirados, e diziam: De onde vêm a este tal sabedoria, e os milagres?
verses.en_web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.en_bbe: And coming into his country, he gave them teaching in their Synagogue, so that they were greatly surprised and said, Where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.pt: Não é este o filho do carpinteiro? E não se chama sua mãe Maria, e seus irmãos Tiago, José, Simão, e Judas?
verses.en_web: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
verses.en_bbe: Is not this the woodworker's son? is not his mother named Mary? and his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?

verses.en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.pt: Não estão todas as suas irmãs conosco? Ora, de onde vem a este tudo isto?
verses.en_web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
verses.en_bbe: And his sisters, are they not all with us? from where, then, has he all these things?

verses.en: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.pt: E ofenderam-se por causa dele. Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não há profeta sem honra, a não ser em sua terra, e em sua casa.
verses.en_web: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”
verses.en_bbe: And they were bitter against him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour but in his country and among his family.

verses.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.pt: E não fez ali muitos milagres por causa da incredulidade deles.
verses.en_web: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.en_bbe: And the works of power which he did there were small in number because they had no faith.
